dialogue.content: （こんにちは、時間になりましたら始めますので宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Hello, we will begin at the scheduled time. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Hello, thank you for meeting with me today.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。初めに年齢・性別。話したい事を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about?

dialogue.content: こんにちは、27歳、女性、職場の人間関係ことです
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm 27 years old, female, and it's about my workplace relationships.

dialogue.content: 職場の人間関係ですね。
dialogue.English: I see, workplace relationships.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今は結婚などはしていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you married?

dialogue.content: はい、独身です
dialogue.English: No, I'm single.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。仕事は何をされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. And what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 事務の仕事をしてます
dialogue.English: I do administrative work.

dialogue.content: なるほど。事務の仕事をしていて人間関係が気になるという事ですね。人間関係ですが。特に具体的な悩みを教えてくれますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you're doing administrative work and are concerned about your relationships there. Could you tell me more specifically about the issue?

dialogue.content: はい同僚３人いるんですが、私は普通に接していて良好な関係だと思っていたんですが、私のことを悪く言っていると人づてに聞いて、不信感を抱いてしまって
dialogue.English: Yes, I have three colleagues, and I thought I was interacting with them normally and that we had a good relationship. But I heard through someone else that they're speaking ill of me, and now I feel distrustful.

dialogue.content: なんだか、以前より仕事がしにくいです
dialogue.English: Somehow, it's become harder to do my job than before.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。同僚の誰かがあなたの悪口を言っていると聴いて仕事がやりにくい状況になってしまったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you heard that one of your colleagues has been bad-mouthing you, and that has made it difficult to work.

dialogue.content: はい普段の会話も、なんだか以前よりしにくくなってしまってみんなの顔色を伺ってしまってしんどいです
dialogue.English: Yes, even everyday conversations have become more difficult than before. I find myself trying to read everyone's expressions, and it's exhausting.

dialogue.content: はい。つらいですよね。仕事だけでも大変なのに人間関係も絡んでくるとつらいとおみます。その中でも頑張っているのですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that must be very difficult. Work is challenging enough on its own, and I imagine it's even harder when relationship issues are involved. You're still doing your best in that situation.

dialogue.content: はい、つらいですありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, it's difficult. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 同僚以外の人から悪口を言われたとありますが。その方とはどんな関係なのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned being spoken ill of by someone other than your colleagues. What is your relationship with that person?

dialogue.content: 同僚が悪口を言っているですね。すみません。
dialogue.English: Oh, so it's your colleagues who are speaking ill of you. My apologies.

dialogue.content: はい会社の上司に「壁を感じる」とか「仕事を疎かにしてる」と聞いている。と言われました
dialogue.English: Yes, my boss told me they had heard things like I "create a wall" or that I'm "neglecting my work."

dialogue.content: そのことでちょっと注意を受けたような形です
dialogue.English: Because of that, it felt like I received a bit of a warning.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは事実な事ですか？噓のことを悪口にして言われたらこまりますからね。
dialogue.English: I see. Is there any truth to that? It would be a problem if they were spreading lies as gossip.

dialogue.content: 私なりに仕事はきちんとしているつもりなので心外でした
dialogue.English: I believe I do my job properly, so I was quite offended.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。同僚とはこれからどうしたいと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: I can understand that. How do you want to handle your relationship with your colleagues going forward?

dialogue.content: 相手との関係をどうしたいとかはありません
dialogue.English: I don't have any particular goal for the relationship.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。仕事が気持ち良く出来れば一番ですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. Is your top priority to be able to work comfortably?

dialogue.content: はい仕事中はどうしても同僚たちともコミュニケーションを取らないといけない場面があるので、その度に何を思われているのかと勘繰ってしまうので、気にならないようになりたいですね
dialogue.English: Yes. At work, there are times when I have to communicate with my colleagues, and every time I do, I find myself second-guessing what they're thinking about me. I'd like to be able to stop worrying about it.

dialogue.content: なるほど。一度、場所を変えて同僚の方達とお食事など言って話して交流を深めるのはどうですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. How about changing the setting and going out for a meal or something with your colleagues to talk and deepen your connection?

dialogue.content: それは、普段からしてますね関係は良好だと思ってたので
dialogue.English: We actually do that regularly. That's why I thought our relationship was good.

dialogue.content: 仕事をしている限り。気になる事だと思いますので。この先を考えてお互いの考えを聴いてみるといいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: As long as you're working together, I think this will continue to be a concern. Thinking about the future, it might be a good idea to listen to each other's perspectives.

dialogue.content: それができていたらここに相談にきていませんよ
dialogue.English: If I could do that, I wouldn't be here for counseling.

dialogue.content: どの同僚が言っていたかもわかりませんし
dialogue.English: And I don't even know which colleague said it.

dialogue.content: 犯人探しはしたくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want to go hunting for the culprit.

dialogue.content: 本当に同僚が悪口を言ったかもわかりませんから犯人探しではなく真実を確かめることは大切だと思います。
dialogue.English: We don't even know for sure if a colleague really said those things, so rather than trying to find a culprit, I think it's important to ascertain the truth.

dialogue.content: 言った言わないを知ることは私にとって必要なことではありません
dialogue.English: Knowing whether they said it or not isn't necessary for me.

dialogue.content: これからも仕事を続けていくつもりなので、同僚との関係を悪くしたくないですしね
dialogue.English: I plan to continue working here, so I don't want to make my relationships with my colleagues worse.

dialogue.content: 私が我慢していればいいので
dialogue.English: So, if I just endure it, that should be fine.

dialogue.content: でも辛いのでここに相談に来ました
dialogue.English: But it's painful, which is why I came here for counseling.

dialogue.content: 我慢する必要はないと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think you need to endure it.

dialogue.content: ではどうすればいいですか？
dialogue.English: Then what should I do?

dialogue.content: 悪口があって今にあたるとして。仕事をやっていくためにも周りとの関係を良くするための話し合いは必要があると思います。
dialogue.English: Assuming the gossip is what led to this situation, I think having a discussion to improve your relationships with those around you is necessary in order to keep working.

dialogue.content: やってみませんか？
dialogue.English: Would you like to give it a try?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: はい。環境も良くなれば仕事もやりやすくなると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. If the environment improves, I think work will become easier as well.

dialogue.content: そうですね、ためしてみます
dialogue.English: You're right; I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 是非とも話し合いをして今よりも良い仕事ができるようになることを願っています。
dialogue.English: I sincerely hope that by talking things over, you'll be able to work in a better environment than you have now.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 試しても、もしも、上手く行かないならまた相談に来てください。
dialogue.English: If you try and it doesn't go well, please come back and talk to me again.

dialogue.content: そうですねその時はまたよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, in that case I would appreciate your help again.

dialogue.content: 一人で悩まないでくださいね。健康が心配ですから。
dialogue.English: Please don't struggle with this alone. I'm concerned about your well-being.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。いつでも気楽に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございましたはい
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Yes.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. This has been a learning experience. Goodbye.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
